summary: Comprehensive pre-deployment testing of LeadGen Pro CRM. Backend: 30/31 tests passed (97%). Frontend: All major pages load and function correctly. Found 1 CRITICAL UI bug - AI Assistant and AI Copilot buttons are positioned behind the sidebar and cannot be clicked.

minor.issue: Test failed due to missing 'prompt' field in request - test script issue, not API bug

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Both AI buttons (AI Sales Coach at bottom-8 left-6 and AI Copilot at bottom-28 left-6) are positioned at x=24px which is behind the sidebar (width 256px). The sidebar has z-50 and intercepts all clicks to these buttons. Users cannot access AI Sales Coach or AI Copilot features.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Move both buttons to the right side of the screen (e.g., right-6 instead of left-6) OR increase their left position to be outside the sidebar (e.g., left-72 = 288px)

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix AI Assistant and AI Copilot button positions - they are behind the sidebar and cannot be clicked. Change 'left-6' to 'right-6' or 'left-72' in both AIAssistant.js (line 248) and AICopilot.js (line 56)
critical_code_review_comments: AIAssistant.js line 248: 'fixed bottom-8 left-6 z-40' - left-6 (24px) is behind sidebar (256px wide)
AICopilot.js line 56: 'fixed bottom-28 left-6 ... z-40' - same issue, behind sidebar
Sidebar.js line 64: 'z-50' - higher z-index than AI buttons (z-40), causing click interception
